title: The Ballad of Hepzibah Gimble 1

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Oh, my dear flower friend. How lovely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, my dear flower friend. How lovely.
Miss Gimble, how are you?

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: I'm old, my dear. The days hurt, the nights hurt more. And I forget!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm old, my dear. The days hurt, the nights hurt more. And I forget!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yet you never forget to mention that you forget.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yet you never forget to mention that you forget.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yet you never forget to mention that you forget.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yet you never forget to mention that you forget.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Do I? See! I even forget that I already mentioned my forgetfulness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I? See! I even forget that I already mentioned my forgetfulness.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe I can give you a reason to remember?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I can give you a reason to remember?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe I can give you a reason to remember?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe I can give you a reason to remember?

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: What kind of reason might that be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of reason might that be?
Redemption?
Why would I seek absolution?
You retired 80 years ago.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: No. Not really. They all needed to find peace. In a way, they were dead before I got to them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Not really. They all needed to find peace. In a way, they were dead before I got to them.
Someone had to do it.
13500 of them?
13497, to be exact.
No regrets?

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: It all worked out as planned. If it hadn't, I wouldn't be here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It all worked out as planned. If it hadn't, I wouldn't be here.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Never be afraid to move past your past. Mistakes happen, and we all do what we must to survive. Life is too precious to waste second guessing ourselves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never be afraid to move past your past. Mistakes happen, and we all do what we must to survive. Life is too precious to waste second guessing ourselves.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Forgetting things is how we endure. And the things I don't forget, I reconcile. I won't carry guilt - my shoulders wouldn't bear it at my age. I advise you do the same. Now, I have tasks on my to-do list and not much time to do them, so good day to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Forgetting things is how we endure. And the things I don't forget, I reconcile. I won't carry guilt - my shoulders wouldn't bear it at my age. I advise you do the same. Now, I have tasks on my to-do list and not much time to do them, so good day to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Happens even to me, and I might be a few months younger than you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Happens even to me, and I might be a few months younger than you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Happens even to me, and I might be a few months younger than you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Happens even to me, and I might be a few months younger than you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha, very amusing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Someone had to burn down a storehouse?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone had to burn down a storehouse?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Someone had to burn down a storehouse?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Someone had to burn down a storehouse?

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: 13497 souls that I have freed from their eternal suffering as the living dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 13497 souls that I have freed from their eternal suffering as the living dead.
Absolution?
Forgiveness?
Why would I seek forgiveness?
Why would I seek redemption?

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Can you remind me a bit about what we are discussing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you remind me a bit about what we are discussing?
That I remember, dear.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The souls you took. Do they haunt you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The souls you took. Do they haunt you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The souls you took. Do they haunt you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The souls you took. Do they haunt you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You took many lives. Any regrets?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You took many lives. Any regrets?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You took many lives. Any regrets?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You took many lives. Any regrets?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's cold.
